title: Axolotl wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,34 62,34' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,34 50,34' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 50,34 56,34' fill='#5ce1e6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='2' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='28' x2='60' y2='28' stroke='#ffd93d' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='22' x2='58' y2='22' stroke='#5ce1e6' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='16' x2='56' y2='16' stroke='#ffd93d' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#f39ac7'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#ffb8d9'/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M22,70 Q10,64 8,50 Q14,52 18,58 Q20,62 24,64' fill='#f39ac7'/>
  <path d='M22,70 Q12,66 10,54 Q15,56 18,60 Q20,64 24,66' fill='#ffb8d9'/>

  <!-- Left gill branches -->
  <path d='M30,50 Q20,40 14,32' stroke='#f06292' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30,52 Q18,48 10,44' stroke='#f06292' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30,54 Q20,56 12,60' stroke='#f06292' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Gill tips left -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='60' r='4' fill='#ff8fab'/>

  <!-- Right gill branches -->
  <path d='M70,50 Q80,40 86,32' stroke='#f06292' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70,52 Q82,48 90,44' stroke='#f06292' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70,54 Q80,56 88,60' stroke='#f06292' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Gill tips right -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='60' r='4' fill='#ff8fab'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='60' r='6' fill='#2b1b3d'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='60' r='6' fill='#2b1b3d'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='68' r='4' fill='#ff6b9d' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='68' r='4' fill='#ff6b9d' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44,72 Q50,78 56,72' stroke='#d6336c' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='86' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f39ac7'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='86' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f39ac7'/>

  <!-- Arms -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='76' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f39ac7' transform='rotate(-20,24,76)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='76' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f39ac7' transform='rotate(20,76,76)'/>
</svg>
